title: President and Prime Minister Visit New Gendarmerie Leadership
summary: President Jimmy Jimmies and Prime Minister obvelt recently visited the new command of the Gendarmerie to meet with officers, observe their work, and discuss the progress being made under the new leadership.
body:
The visit was also an opportunity to show support for the newly appointed command and the work being carried out by its officers.

Following the visit, the President expressed his confidence in the future of the force:

***“I wish the best of luck to the new leadership of the Gendarmerie. Always good to stop by and talk to the officers. The Gendarmerie will be the pride of our law enforcement once again.”***

The visit comes as the Gendarmerie continues to develop under its new command, following alongated periods of inactivity from its predecessors. Early impressions of the work and progress made so far have been highly positive, with the leadership appearing determined to strengthen the force and restore it to it's former glory.

title: Government Announces First Major Transparency Reports
summary: For the first time, the French government is set to release a comprehensive series of ministerial reports detailing the work being done across the government.
body:
Prime Minister Obvelt announced that ministers will publish their respective reports throughout the coming week in accordance with the [Government Transparency Law](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cqVSaSkgGsBJeGXDOEoTitBofgFORYh31_FkbghKs88/edit?usp=sharing), giving citizens a look into the work, achievements, and priorities of the administration.

The announcement marks a significant moment for government accountability. While previous administrations have communicated their policies and achievements, the Jimmies–Obvelt government is presenting the publication of these reports as a major step towards providing the public with a clearer and more detailed image of government activity.


***“I want all citizens to be aware of the work being undertaken across government and I am proud of the progress we have brought to France.”***

The Prime Minister also directed citizens toward the government's [Government Trello](https://trello.com/b/cQiaWUvD/jimmies-x-obvelt-government-policy-agenda), where completed work and ongoing priorities can be followed in bettter detail.

### A New Standard for Accountability

The publication represents what could become a new standard for governmental transparency in France. With ministers publicly reporting on their respective areas of responsibility, citizens will have greater visibility into how the government is operating and what is being delivered.

The current administration has placed transparency and accountability at the centre of its government, and the coming week will provide the public with its first major opportunity to assess that commitment through the work of individual ministries.

As the reports are released, attention will now turn to what each minister has accomplished, and what government intends work on next.

title: JaydonAlFayeed Responds Following Saint-Tropez Incident
summary: Following the recent Saint-Tropez incident that left two ministers injured and resulted in JaydonAlFayeed being dishonorably discharged from the Navy, the former servicemember and current political candidate has issued a formal response addressing the circumstances surrounding the event.
body:
In a statement, he admitted responsibility but claimed the attack was carried out using a different avatar and therefore to "to give more RPs [roleplays] for the police", referencing comments made by President Jimmy Jimmies about crime creating activity.

Critics argue his reasoning shows no regard for the real impact of his actions and the safety of government officials.

body: The joint appearance comes amid a period of increased activity from the Jimmies–Obvelt government, with both leaders continuing to work closely on their government's agenda. The message was difficult to miss: **unity remains at the heart of the administration.**

title: Opposition Leader Accused of Attacking Government Officials.. Again
summary: The incident surrounding opposition leader JaydonAlFayeed has taken a more serious turn, with Le Littoral being informed by independent sources that the individual involved has been identified as JaydonAlFayeed, which has been confirmed by multiple officials.
body:
The incident reportedly involved an attempted attack against President Jimmy Jimmies, while further allegations have emerged that ministers were also targeted.

JaydonAlFayeed has already acknowledged committing an offence, though he has argued that he acted outside his role as a political leader, claiming that his intention was to generate additional roleplay for law enforcement. He seems to have abandoned that, using his actual avatar for this recent attack.

**Will JaydonAlFayeed resign?**
With the opposition leader now accused of targeting senior government officials, pressure may grow for JaydonAlFayeed to address whether he can continue serving in political office.

title: France in Mourning: President Jimmy Jimmies Fatally Shot
summary: Prime Minister Obvelt assumes the presidency following a deadly attack that has plunged the nation into shock.
body:
France has been thrown into mourning following the assassination of President Jimmy Jimmies, who was fatally shot today after returning to Saint-Tropez from New York, where he had publicly expressed support for the Mediterranean Union.

According to a statement from the Élysée Palace, the President was approaching the steps of the Presidential Resort when a gunman opened fire. He was officially declared dead at 9:41 CEST.

The Élysée identified the alleged gunman as a left-wing citizen reportedly supportive of, and cooperating with, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps.


### Obvelt Assumes the Presidency

In an immediate response to the tragedy, Prime Minister Obvelt took the Oath of Office at 9:43 CEST, assuming the position of Acting President.

President Jimmies’ death marks a devastating moment in the nation’s political history. As France mourns its leader, attention now turns to the investigation, the security of government officials, and the future of the administration.

title: Acting President Obvelt to Announce Funeral Arrangements for Late President Jimmies
summary: France prepares to bid farewell to its fallen leader following the assassination that shocked the nation.
body:
Acting President **Obvelt **is expected to announce funeral arrangements for the late President **Jimmy Jimmies** in the coming days, following his tragic death in Saint-Tropez.

The announcement will provide further details on how France will honour its former head of state, whose assassination has left the nation in mourning and prompted an unprecedented transition of power.

As Acting President, **Obvelt** now faces the responsibility of guiding the country through this difficult period while ensuring that his predecessor receives an appropriate farewell.

The funeral is expected to be a significant moment for the French Republic, offering citizens and government officials alike an opportunity to pay their respects.

title: New Investment App?
summary: Could TradeX become France's biggest name in the investment world?
body:
TradeX, the new French-owned stock market service opens eyes across the investment world as many use it to start stock trading.

Le Littoral reached out to the publisher of the application, who wishes to remain anonymous, and retrieved information about the service. The publisher stated that, "TradeX and TradeX Premium are trustworthy services with encrypted user data, made by investors for investors."

What could this mean for investors? As this exciting new opportunity arises, more and more people are introduced to the stock trading world every day thanks to the release of TradeX.

title: Funeral date announced for late French President
summary: Funeral announced for the late president by his successor.
body:
French Acting President Obvelt announces date and plans for the funeral of his predecessor, Jimmy_Jimmies.

On the 26th of October 2026 at 4PM, a ceremonial funeral for the late president will be held. This event highlights a staple of unity within the French community, and an opportunity for all to mourn together.

title: Security Developments for France
summary: French Prime Minister, PoopSnake04, expresses support for domestic security development
body:
French Prime Minister, PoopSnake04, expresses support for French security firm, Scout.

The French government invoiced Scout 2,080,000 euros for the instalation of 93 security cameras and 24 metal detectors across the municipality of Saint Tropez, and the island of Port Cros.

Le Littoral reached out to the founder of Scout, ProjectTomat, who assures safety and effectiveness in his company's products.

title: President Announces Deployments in Strait of Hormuz
summary: President Obvelt deems Iran's deescalation efforts insufficient
body:
Following the recent assassination of former French President Jimmy Jimmies, the Islamic State of Iran expresses condolences to the French Republic, however their deescalation attempts are deemed insufficient by President Obvelt as Iran fails to make a formal apology addressing the circumstances.

As a precaution, 2 Dassault Rafale fighter jets and an E-2 Hawkeye Early Warning Aircraft have been deployed to the Strait of Hormuz to guarantee the safety of French vessels and provide situational awareness to the French Government.

President Obvelt continues to demand Iran's accountability in the former president's death.

title: France Summons Iranian Supreme Leader Following Attempted Drone Attack on Destroyer
summary: President Obvelt and Prime Minister Poopsnake call for answers as tensions escalate following an alleged attack on a French naval vessel.
body:
The French government has summoned the Iranian Supreme Leader to France following an attempted drone attack against a French destroyer, marking a potentially serious escalation in relations between the two countries.

President Obvelt and Prime Minister Poopsnake are leading the government's response, with the summons signalling that France intends to demand answers over the incident and its implications for national security.

The development comes at an already turbulent time for France, following the assassination of former President Jimmy Jimmies. With the country still recovering from the loss of its former leader, the latest incident raises further concerns over the security of French personnel and military assets.

Although the full circumstances surrounding the attempted attack remain unclear, the French leadership appears determined to address the matter directly.

title: Obvelt and Poopsnake Reach Record 93.3% Approval Ratings
summary: President Obvelt and Prime Minister Poopsnake achieve the highest approval ratings ever recorded in French history.
body:
Le Littoral has officially released the results of its latest approval rating survey, revealing public opinion on President Obvelt, Prime Minister PoopSnake04 and the current French government.

President **Obvelt**, Prime Minister **PoopSnake04** and Minister of Foreign Affairs **NinoE123456789** have all received **93.3% approval ratings**, marking the highest levels of support among the officials surveyed.

The Minister of the Interior, **RoPlayerLOL**, received **86.7% approval**, whilst other members of the government received less favourable results.

The Minister of Armed Forces, **Sx6776**, recorded **73.3% disapproval**, followed by the Minister of Economy and Finance, **Geoxvsprogamer**, with **60% disapproval**. The Minister of Transport, **s_pecialmissionunit**, received **80% disapproval**, having been dismissed earlier this week.

The results highlight differing levels of public confidence across the French administration, with strong approval for the President, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs.
